rules.statement: A co-owner who has made improvements to a jointly owned property cannot claim half the cost of those improvements from the other co-owner if that co-owner has sold their share, unless there is a partition and the improved portion is not fully compensated.
rules.supporting_quote: "X has still his right to compensation under the Partition Ordinance, in the event of a partition, should he not get the whole ' of the portion of the land which he has improved; and if Y has purported to sell to the purchaser of his interest the improvements effected by X, that is a matter between themselves, in which X is not concerned."
